items.text: Tencent open-weighted Hy4 Flash, a 224B-parameter multimodal model with 12B active parameters and a one-million-token context window.
items.text_zh: 腾讯开源 Hy4 Flash：2240亿参数、多模态、每次激活120亿参数，支持百万上下文。
items.cat_take_en: The combination of a sparse architecture and million-token context makes local deployment more plausible, but hardware costs remain substantial.
items.cat_take_zh: 稀疏架构叠加百万上下文提升本地部署吸引力，但显存和推理成本仍是主要门槛。

items.text: SID AI released SID-2, an agentic search model whose swarm mode reportedly reached 0.720 NDCG through coordinated retrieval agents.
items.text_zh: SID AI 发布 SID-2 智能搜索模型，其协同代理 Swarm 模式据称达到 0.720 NDCG。
items.cat_take_en: The result supports coordinated retrieval as a credible quality lever, though benchmark gains may not translate to faster user experiences.
items.cat_take_zh: 结果证明协同检索有质量潜力，但基准提升未必能转化为更快的真实搜索体验。

items.text: Anthropic added Code Mode to Claude Code, allowing JavaScript to chain tool calls for more efficient multi-step coding workflows.
items.text_zh: Anthropic 为 Claude Code 加入 Code Mode，可用 JavaScript 串联工具调用，提升多步骤编程效率。
items.cat_take_en: JavaScript orchestration could reduce agent overhead, but it also expands the attack surface of unreviewed tool-execution logic.
items.cat_take_zh: JavaScript 编排可能降低代理开销，却也扩大了未经审查的工具执行攻击面。

items.text: Microsoft introduced MAI Licensed Weights, letting selected enterprises customize Microsoft AI models with proprietary data while keeping deployment inside Azure.
items.text_zh: 微软推出 MAI Licensed Weights，允许企业用专有数据定制模型，并将部署限制在 Azure 内。
items.cat_take_en: Licensed weights give regulated buyers more control than APIs, but Azure-only deployment preserves Microsoft’s infrastructure lock-in.
items.cat_take_zh: 授权权重让受监管企业获得更多控制，但仅限 Azure 部署也加深了微软的基础设施绑定。

items.text: Perplexity launched Orchestrator API preview, automatically routing requests across more than 45 models from multiple providers.
items.text_zh: Perplexity 预览 Orchestrator API，可在多家供应商的 45 个以上模型之间自动路由请求。
items.cat_take_en: Routing can simplify multi-model operations, but customers trade direct model control for Perplexity’s opaque selection and billing layer.
items.cat_take_zh: 自动路由简化多模型运营，却让客户用模型控制权换取 Perplexity 的黑箱选择和计费层。

items.text: Cognition introduced Devin Bots, collaborative software-engineering agents that divide planning, coding, testing, and review across specialized bots.
items.text_zh: Cognition 推出 Devin Bots，由多个专业代理分工完成规划、编码、测试和审查。
items.cat_take_en: Specialized bot handoffs could multiply developer throughput, but the reported 4.5x gain still depends on reliable review and coordination.
items.cat_take_zh: 专业代理交接可能放大开发效率，但所谓 4.5 倍提升仍依赖可靠审查与协同。

items.text: Kling Image 4.0 launched with native 8K generation, long text rendering, and batch image creation for professional visual workflows.
items.text_zh: 可灵 Kling Image 4.0 发布，支持原生 8K、长文本渲染和批量出图，面向专业视觉创作。
items.cat_take_en: Native 8K and stronger typography target commercial production directly, although inference cost may limit routine high-resolution use.
items.cat_take_zh: 原生 8K 与更强排版直击商业生产，但推理成本可能限制高分辨率的日常使用。

items.text: Krea launched Video Swap, a workflow for changing characters, products, and backgrounds in existing footage with precise control.
items.text_zh: Krea 推出 Video Swap，可在现有视频中精准替换角色、产品和背景。
items.cat_take_en: Editable video elements lower reshoot costs for creators, while identity and consent controls remain the unresolved production risk.
items.cat_take_zh: 可编辑视频元素能降低重拍成本，但身份授权和同意机制仍是落地风险。

items.text: ElevenLabs released Scribe v3 Live Medical, a real-time transcription model reporting 12.8% word error rate on medical benchmarks.
items.text_zh: ElevenLabs 发布 Scribe v3 Live Medical，实时医疗转录模型在医疗基准上的词错误率为 12.8%。
items.cat_take_en: The benchmark lead could accelerate healthcare voice agents, but clinical deployment still requires terminology validation and liability controls.
items.cat_take_zh: 基准领先有望推动医疗语音代理，但临床部署仍需术语验证和责任控制。

items.text: Meshy launched the Z-Axis Awards, backed by $300,000 in prizes, and introduced a million-dollar fund for 3D creators.
items.text_zh: Meshy 发起 Z-Axis Awards，提供 30 万美元奖金，并推出面向 3D 创作者的百万美元基金。
items.cat_take_en: Large creator incentives can expand AI-3D experimentation, but prize funding may concentrate attention on showcase assets rather than durable tools.
items.cat_take_zh: 大额激励会扩大 AI 3D 实验，但资金也可能让注意力偏向展示作品而非耐用工具。

items.text: Replit Desktop lets Devin Agent work with files in shared local folders, build tools, and turn local data into shareable reports.
items.text_zh: Replit Desktop 允许 Agent 操作共享本地文件夹、构建工具，并将本地数据转成可分享报告。
items.cat_take_en: Local-file access makes agents more useful beyond browser sandboxes, but permission boundaries become critical once private folders enter the workflow.
items.cat_take_zh: 本地文件访问让代理突破浏览器沙盒，但一旦触及私密文件，权限边界就成为关键。

items.text: Alibaba Qwen announced Qwen4-Max availability on Runware, extending access to the model through a third-party generative media platform.
items.text_zh: 阿里通义宣布 Qwen4-Max 登陆 Runware，通过第三方生成媒体平台扩大模型可用性。
items.cat_take_en: Third-party distribution can speed adoption without new infrastructure, but it also fragments usage data and model-level product control.
items.cat_take_zh: 第三方分发能降低采用门槛，却会分散使用数据并削弱模型方的产品控制。

items.text: HeyGen introduced Avatar 6, which it said 84% of test viewers failed to distinguish from real people in its avatar evaluation.
items.text_zh: HeyGen 推出 Avatar 6，称在其评测中，84% 的测试观众未能分辨其与真人的差异。
items.cat_take_en: The result signals a major realism jump for presenters, but indistinguishability raises disclosure and impersonation risks for every deployment.
items.cat_take_zh: 逼真度跃升利好虚拟主持人，却让披露义务和冒用风险在所有场景中上升。
